name: Smith Machine Decline Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Position a decline bench so the bar tracks over your lower chest, secure your feet and lie back.
Set your shoulders against the pad, take an underhand grip just outside shoulder width and wrap your thumbs before releasing the hooks.
Lower the bar slowly down toward your lower chest while keeping your elbows tucked tightly toward your ribs.
Press the bar smoothly back up to full arm extension and rerack carefully when finished.
tips: Keep the wrists aligned over your forearms as the bar descends.
Keep your elbows tucked forward and close to your sides throughout the descent.
